verdict.rationale: The pack never documents attributing signups or revenue to specific emails or flows. It names "Goals" as an automation component but does not say they measure conversions or revenue. Generic mentions of analyzing or reporting on message performance do not establish attribution beyond opens and clicks, and data-out exports to analytics platforms are an adjacent workaround, not the product's own attribution.

support.subject: As a founder, I can attribute signups or revenue to specific emails and flows, not just opens and clicks
